title.zh: Bybit 与 Franklin Templeton 合作，将代币化货币市场基金份额用作交易抵押品
title.en: Bybit and Franklin Templeton Form Strategic Collaboration to Expand Access to Tokenized Investing

current_state.zh: Franklin Templeton and Bybit launched a program letting eligible institutional clients pledge Benji-issued tokenized money market fund shares, held in off-exchange custody, as collateral for USDT/USDC credit lines used to trade on Bybit.
